laws.rule: Cheile Bicazului-Hășmaș National Park: visit fee 10 lei a day for adults and children over 14, 5 lei a day for children up to 14 (2026 tariffs). Tickets online on the park site. (No RBA rate for RON; at the Banca Națională a României rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 3.355 RON: 10 lei ≈ A$2.98; 5 lei ≈ A$1.49)
laws.heading: Cheile Bicazului-Hășmaș
